---
name: run-sdlc
description: Run a complex change through the complete evidence-gated financial SDLC
agent: gts-orchestrator
---

Treat the text supplied with this prompt as the requested software change.
Assign a stable change ID, classify risk conservatively, and operate the durable
state machine with the `operate-sdlc-run` skill.

Do not start implementation until authoritative sources, atomic requirements,
ambiguities, architecture, threat model, and rollback plan satisfy their exit
criteria. Continue automatically through bounded implementation slices,
deterministic gates, independent falsification, security review, release
evidence, pre-production, business invariants, and controlled operations.

Pause only for missing normative decisions, inaccessible required systems, or
the protected-environment human approval. Never manufacture evidence or claim
certainty. Finish with the exact durable state, commit, evidence paths,
failures, remediation count, and remaining accountable-human action.
